Confirms the three `.testimonial-card` blocks are a genuine repeated component (same shape, same role — a quote + avatar). Good, matches what's visually obvious.

### Priority list
1. `.testimonial-card` (×3, ~65,728px² each, largest repeated blocks) — the dominant repeated component on the page; red-twine confirms same shape/role, so must be built as one identical structure repeated verbatim with each person's real quote/avatar alt text.
2. `h1` "What people say" (~46,768px²) — full-width heading at the top of `#main`, sets the page's only real typographic statement.
3. `#main` (~311,497px², the whole page body) — there is zero CSS anywhere in the source (no `<link>`, no `<style>`), so its "theme" is just the browser UA default (white bg, black serif-ish default text) — nothing to invent here, just don't accidentally add styling that isn't in the original.

Given there's no stylesheet at all in the source, I won't fabricate a Tailwind theme — that would be adding fidelity-breaking styling not present in the original. I'll clone the exact semantic markup.
